folders.title: Folders
folders.intro: Döndü only looks at the folders you choose. Scanning never touches files; nothing moves without your approval.
folders.emptyBody: Add the folders you want to tidy, such as Desktop, Downloads or Documents.

rejected.system: This is a system folder and cannot be selected.
rejected.app: Döndü's own data folder cannot be selected.
rejected.nested: It is already inside a selected folder.

check.cloudHint: This folder syncs with the cloud. Files that are not downloaded are left alone and shown separately in the report.

problem.missing: This folder no longer exists or has moved.
problem.read: This folder cannot be read. Check its permissions.
problem.readMac: macOS did not allow access to this folder — open Privacy settings to grant it.
problem.write: This folder is not writable. Scanning works, but applying a plan needs write access.
problem.writeWin: Windows Security may be blocking writes here (Ransomware protection). Scanning works.

scan.title: Scan
scan.readOnly: Scanning is read-only: nothing is moved or changed.
scan.emptyBody_one: Scan {{count}} folder to see a summary here.
scan.emptyBody_other: Scan {{count}} folders to see a summary here.
scan.noFolders: First choose the folders to tidy.
scan.cancelled: The scan was stopped. The summary below shows what was found until then.
scan.cloudSkipped_one: Note: {{count}} file is in the cloud and not downloaded; I left it alone.
scan.cloudSkipped_other: Note: {{count}} files are in the cloud and not downloaded; I left them alone.

errors.scan_failed: The scan could not be completed.
